focus: Read the goal hook (.skilled/hooks/goal/**, per-runtime adapters, goal-core.cjs, goal-slice.cjs, bin/goal.cjs) and its tests; check goal claims in v4.0.0.16 and v4.0.2.0 against code with path:line; run the hook's suites read-only; report bugs, drift and sk-code misalignment.

label: packet_budget reports 'unknown' whenever the spec-kit manifest is missing or carries no goalDurableBudget block, and budgetState maps null to 'unknown' for both a manifest-less repo and an unbudgeted phase child; since the GOAL POSTURE RULE instructs sending only at packet_budget=ok, such a workspace can never satisfy the gate and the model withholds the goal slice permanently with no signal that the cause is a missing manifest rather than an oversized file.

renderChatSlice scrubs only HTML comments, --- dividers, heading section numbers and blank runs, so a prose template instruction survives verbatim into the chat slice (measured: '> **Note:** replace every heading below with your own words.' intact, durable 87 chars vs chat 83), while the framework's GOAL POSTURE RULE promises the slice carries no template instructions.

The resend reminder hardcodes '4000 characters' as a prose literal while resolveGoalBudget reads errorChars from spec-kit-docs.json, so the injected steering text agrees with the validator only by coincidence of today's manifest value and would tell the model to cut to a stale limit after any manifest change; the module's own comment at :308 states the opposite intent.

No Claude or Codex goal adapter exists: adapters are present only for cursor, devin, dsh, opencode and pi, while .claude/hooks and .codex/hooks carry no goal entry, yet the framework's GOAL POSTURE RULE states a Claude Code delivery clause (send the slice alone in one fenced block) as always-on; on those two runtimes nothing injects the goal slice, evaluates resendPending or appends the reminder, making the stated rule inert and leaving two of seven runtimes silently unbound.

v4.0.2.0 states as accomplished fact that /goal-dsh and the dsh_goal tool run the shared goal command and that dsh sessions get goals, but .dsh/plugins carries no goal entry while the peer runtime registers its plugin by name in .opencode/plugins; the adapter source and its suite exist under .skilled/hooks/goal/dsh/, so the installation half is unverified rather than disproven (confidence medium: dsh may register through a patch manifest this iteration did not open).

The packet report prints packet_durable_chars and packet_budget but neither chat_chars nor the overage, so when budget is over the model is told to cut the file without being told by how much or whether the message it would send already fits; because chatSlice is a monotone reduction of durableSlice, a file can measure over while its chat rendering is within budget, and two already-derivable fields (chat_chars, over_by) would close the gap.

The goal hook cluster is green: node --test over goal/lib/*.test.cjs and bin/goal.test.cjs reports 133 tests, 133 pass, 0 fail, including coverage of phase-child budget exemption, phase-parent nesting, the generator-hardening switch and symlink containment.

The iteration prompt pack names v4.0.0.16 as a source of goal release claims, but grep -i goal over .skilled/changelog/skilled/v4.0.0.16.md returns nothing; all live goal claims are in v4.0.2.0 plus v4.0.0.2/.13/.14. Premise corrected rather than substituted silently.

The two anchors flagged in iteration 18 hold in the goal core: resolveRepoRoot delegates to goalSlice.resolveWorkspaceRoot and resolveStateDir joins the resolved repo root with STATE_SUBDIR, so goal state anchors at the repository root rather than the invocation cwd.
